jobs.author: Band designer
jobs.message:
Done—only the band was changed to an upright, over-the-head headphone-style arch. I retained its original curved channel and rebuilt the band’s offset end connection.

All seven other parts remain unchanged. Some previously band-supported features are now separated from it because they were left fixed as requested. Fit and structural performance have not been validated.
jobs.task: Can you move the band in our wearable to an over-the-head band instead, so it looks like over-the-head headphones and is a familiar form factor? Preserve all other parts. Only work on the band.
